headline: OpenAI and AWS Release Major Updates on AI Security and Functionality Enhancements

items.title: Our response to the TanStack npm supply chain attack
items.summary: OpenAI details its response to the TanStack 'Mini Shai-Hulud' supply chain attack, outlining protections taken, such as securing systems and signing certificates. They urge macOS users to update OpenAI apps by June 12, 2026. This response strengthens defenses against similar attacks in the future.
items.why_it_matters: Security vulnerabilities in AI supply chains can disrupt operations and compromise data integrity.

items.title: Build financial document processing with Pulse AI and Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: AWS introduces a pipeline combining Pulse AI's document understanding with Amazon Bedrock's AI services. This setup addresses the complexities of processing financial documents by extracting information and fine-tuning models efficiently.

items.title: Fine-tune LLM with Databricks Unity Catalog and Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: AWS demonstrates a secure LLM fine-tuning workflow integrating Databricks Unity Catalog with Amazon SageMaker AI. The process uses Amazon EMR Serverless for data preprocessing, allowing secure data access and service integration for model fine-tuning.

items.title: Think Twice, Act Once: Verifier-Guided Action Selection For Embodied Agents
items.summary: New research explores the use of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to enhance the reasoning capabilities of embodied agents. The study focuses on integrating strong vision and language models to improve task-solving efficiency in real-world environments.

items.title: Show HN: Needle: We Distilled Gemini Tool Calling into a 26M Model
items.summary: Cactus open-sourced Needle, a 26M parameter function-calling model designed for efficiency on consumer devices. It runs at 6000 tokens/second prefill and 1200 tokens/second decode, focusing on agentic models that operate on budget hardware.

all_items.title: Building a safe, effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows
all_items.summary: Learn how OpenAI built a secure sandbox for Codex on Windows, enabling safe, efficient coding agents with controlled file access and network restrictions.

all_items.title: Our response to the TanStack npm supply chain attack
all_items.summary: OpenAI details its response to the TanStack “Mini Shai-Hulud” supply chain attack, outlines protections taken to secure systems and signing certificates, and explains why macOS users must update OpenAI apps by June 12, 2026. Learn what happened, what was affected, and how OpenAI is strengthening defenses against evolving software supply chain threats.

all_items.title: How finance teams use Codex
all_items.summary: See how finance teams can use Codex to build MBRs, reporting packs, variance bridges, model checks, and planning scenarios from real work inputs.

all_items.title: Build financial document processing with Pulse AI and Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: This post demonstrates how to build a documentation extraction and model fine-tuning pipeline that addresses challenges when processing the complex financial documents. By combining Pulse AI's advanced document understanding capabilities with the powerful AI services of Amazon Bedrock, organizations can achieve enterprise-grade accuracy and extract contextually relevant financial insights at scale.

all_items.title: Build real-time voice streaming applications with Amazon Nova Sonic and WebRTC
all_items.summary: Building end-to-end live streaming applications with real-time voice interaction presents several challenges. This post introduces a solution based on Amazon Nova 2 Sonic (Nova Sonic) and Amazon Kinesis Video Streams WebRTC (WebRTC) that addresses these challenges. In this post, we’ll walk through the solution architecture, implementation patterns, and two real-world scenario examples.

all_items.title: Securing AI agents: How AWS and Cisco AI Defense scale MCP and A2A deployments
all_items.summary: The Cisco and AWS partnership addresses three challenges enterprises face when scaling AI agents: visibility gaps, security bottlenecks, and compliance risks. In this post, we explore how you can overcome AI security challenges through automated scanning and unified governance.

all_items.title: Fine-tune LLM with Databricks Unity Catalog and Amazon SageMaker AI
all_items.summary: In this post, we demonstrate how to build a secure, complete LLM fine-tuning workflow that integrates Unity Catalog with Amazon SageMaker AI using Amazon EMR Serverless for preprocessing. The solution shows how to securely access governed data, maintain lineage across services, fine-tune the Ministral-3-3B-Instruct model, and register trained artifacts back into Unity Catalog. With this approach, you can continue using your existing services while preserving central governance, tracking data lin

all_items.title: How Amazon Finance streamlines regulatory inquiries by using generative AI on AWS
all_items.summary: In this post, we demonstrate how Amazon FinTech teams are using Amazon Bedrock and other AWS services to build a scalable AI application to transform how regulatory inquiries are handled. Each team using this solution creates and maintains its own dedicated knowledge base, populated with that team's specific documents and reference materials.

all_items.title: Automate schema generation for intelligent document processing
all_items.summary: In this post, we'll show you how our multi-document discovery feature solves this problem. It serves as an automated pre-processing step, analyzing unknown documents, clustering them by type, and generating schemas ready for the IDP Accelerator. You'll learn how the new capability uses visual embeddings for automatic clustering and agents for schema generation. We'll also walk you through running the solution on your own document collections.

all_items.title: Navigating EU AI Act requirements for LLM fine-tuning on Amazon SageMaker AI
all_items.summary: In this post, we show you how to set up FLOPs tracking during LLM fine-tuning using the open source Fine-Tuning FLOPs Meter toolkit on Amazon SageMaker AI. You learn how to determine your compliance status with a single configuration flag and generate audit-ready documentation.
